title: Kripke
html:
Kripke was born to Lera and King Chronoron and is Pavel's illegitamate elder full-brother. An arrogant yet competent would-be king of Yander; he commands the loyalty of Robert, Avel and Gattler. Pavel and Kripke's rivalry for the throne drives much of the plot of the first three books. After Peter, Kripke was reputedly the greatest swordsman in the Universe of Yander and Shadow. A few centuries before the events of the first novels, he and Pavel decided to settle their rivalry in a duel to the death. In the event, Kripke, fearing Chronoron's wrath, left Pavel, gravely injured, on Earth in the 17th century. Pavel recovered physically but his memory was gone. Kripke maintained that Pavel had left Yander of his own volition, but Chronoron would often hint that he suspected Kripke of killing Pavel. When Chronoron disappeared, lured into Shadow to find a tool to fix the Pattern after Jon damaged it, Kripke allied with Avel and Robert to hold the throne.
